ui.openWine.desc: Open a wine's detail page. Accepts the wine id or an options object.

ui.openWineFilters.desc: Open the wine filters, where the user filters wines by color, region, grape, vintage and other attributes.

ui.openRack.desc: Open a rack. Accepts the rack id or an options object.

ui.openRackEditor.desc: Open the rack editor (expert mode) for a rack. Accepts the rack id or an options object.

ui.openTastingNote.desc: Open a tasting note. Accepts the note id or an options object.

ui.openUrl.desc: Open a URL. Accepts a URL string or an options object.

ui.openDansTonPloc.desc: Open the Dans ton PLOC view.

ui.openMiniApps.desc: Open the mini apps view. Same as sdk.miniApps.open.

ui.openOrder.desc: Open an order. Accepts the order id or an options object.

ui.openVendor.desc: Open a vendor. Accepts the vendor id or an options object.

ui.openOwner.desc: Open an owner. Accepts the owner id or an options object.

ui.openIconPreferences.desc: Open the app icon preferences (iOS only).

ui.share.desc: Open the native share sheet. Accepts a local file path (string), an array of paths, or an options object { base64 } like sdk.ui.shareImage. Shortcut for shareFiles.
ui.share.snippet:
const files = await sdk.csv.createFiles();
await sdk.ui.share(files.map(f => f.path));

ui.shareFiles.desc: Open the native share sheet with one or several local files (e.g. from sdk.csv.createFiles or sdk.backup.createBackupFile). Accepts a path or an array of paths.
ui.shareFiles.snippet:
const file = await sdk.backup.createBackupFile();
await sdk.ui.shareFiles(file.path);

ui.shareImage.desc: Open the native share sheet with a base64 image.

ui.shareText.desc: Open the native share sheet with a text. Accepts a string or an options object { text }.

cellar.getInfo.desc: Get all cellar information in one object: identifier, empty and locked (booleans; a locked cellar prevents synchronization), currency (ISO code, e.g. "EUR"), size (in bytes) and counts of wines, bottles, tastingNotes, racks, orders, documents, vendors and owners.

cellar.wine.get.desc: Get a wine by its id.
cellar.wine.get.snippet:
const wine = await sdk.cellar.wine.get("WINE_ID");
return wine;

cellar.wine.find.desc: Find wines with a search text (string, or { query }). The text is matched like the app's search field. Return a Collection.
cellar.wine.find.snippet:
const results = await sdk.cellar.wine.find("Margaux");
return results.map(w => w.name).toArray();

cellar.wine.findFirst.desc: Get the first wine matching a search text (string, or { query }), or null.
cellar.wine.findFirst.snippet:
const wine = await sdk.cellar.wine.findFirst("Margaux");
return wine?.name;

network.fetchBase64.desc: Download a resource and return it as base64. Accepts a URL string or an options object. Default timeout is 30000 ms, set params.timeout (ms) to change it, or 0 for no timeout.

network.download.desc: Download a URL to a local file, streamed to disk. Accepts a URL string or an options object. Return { path, size } (null on failure). Pass the path to sdk.backup.restoreBackupFile.

network.request.desc: Send an HTTP request and return { status, headers, body } (body as text, null on failure). Accepts a URL string (GET) or an options object. Default method is GET. Default timeout is 30000 ms, set params.timeout (ms) to change it, or 0 for no timeout. For binary content use fetchBase64 or download.

network.upload.desc: Upload a local file (e.g. from sdk.backup.createBackupFile) to a URL, streamed from disk. Return { status, body }. Default method is PUT.

dialog.alert.desc: Show an information dialog. Accepts a message string or an options object.
dialog.alert.snippet:
await sdk.dialog.alert({ title: "Info", message: "Operation completed." });
await sdk.dialog.alert("Done.");

dialog.confirm.desc: Show a confirmation dialog and return true if confirmed, false otherwise.
dialog.confirm.snippet:
const ok = await sdk.dialog.confirm({ title: "Delete", message: "Delete this wine?", okLabel: "Delete" });
return ok;

dialog.prompt.desc: Show an input dialog and return the entered text, or null if cancelled.
dialog.prompt.snippet:
const name = await sdk.dialog.prompt({ message: "Your name?", placeholder: "Name" });
return name;

dialog.toast.desc: Show a short non-blocking message (toast) that disappears on its own. Accepts a text string or an options object. Resolve as soon as the toast is shown, without waiting for the user.
dialog.toast.snippet:
await sdk.dialog.toast("Wine added");
await sdk.dialog.toast({ text: "Saved" });

dialog.pick.desc: Show the native selection screen and return the chosen item, or null if cancelled. Items are ids (string[]) or { id, text }[] objects, with plain ids the native app shows its own label. The result is always an { id, text } object (text is null if unknown). Ids must be unique. Accepts an items array or an options object.

dialog.pickMany.desc: Same as dialog.pick but allows several selections. Return an array of { id, text } objects (text is null if unknown), or null if cancelled.

haptics.play.desc: Play a haptic feedback. Accepts a type string or an options object. Types are in sdk.haptics.TYPE: success, warning, error, impact.light, impact.medium, impact.heavy, selection. Return true if played, false if unsupported or disabled on this device (never throws for that). Resolve immediately.

haptics.success.desc: Play the success haptic. Return true if played, false otherwise.

haptics.warning.desc: Play the warning haptic. Return true if played, false otherwise.

haptics.error.desc: Play the error haptic. Return true if played, false otherwise.

haptics.impact.desc: Play an impact haptic of the given style, from sdk.haptics.IMPACT: light, medium (default) or heavy. Return true if played, false otherwise.

haptics.selection.desc: Play the selection haptic, a small tick for a value change (picker, slider). Return true if played, false otherwise.

clipboard.copy.desc: Copy a text to the system clipboard. Accepts the text or an options object.

backup.getInfo.desc: Get all backup information in one object: enabled, canEnable, status (compare with sdk.backup.STATUS), lastBackupDate (PLOC server) and lastManualBackupDate, both Date or null.

backup.enable.desc: Enable automatic backup. Return true if it is now enabled; false if it could not be enabled, in which case open the backup center so the user can fix it.

backup.backupNow.desc: Send the order to back up to the PLOC server now. Poll getInfo().status to follow it.

backup.createBackupFile.desc: Create a manual backup file and return { path, size } (null on failure). Pass the path to sdk.network.upload.
backup.createBackupFile.snippet:
const file = await sdk.backup.createBackupFile();
return file;

backup.restoreBackupFile.desc: Restore a backup from a local file (e.g. from sdk.network.download). Accepts the file path or an options object. Replaces the user's data; the app asks for confirmation. Return true if restored.
backup.restoreBackupFile.snippet:
const file = await sdk.network.download("https://example.com/backup.co");
return await sdk.backup.restoreBackupFile(file.path);

ploud.getInfo.desc: Get all Ploud information in one object: enabled, canEnable (an account is available), status (compare with sdk.ploud.STATUS), server, deviceIdentifier, lastSyncDate (Date or null) and cellarLocked (true while the cellar is locked, which prevents synchronization).

ploud.syncNow.desc: Send the order to synchronize with Ploud now. Return true if accepted; false if not (e.g. cellar locked, see getInfo().cellarLocked). Poll getInfo().status to follow it.

ploud.open.desc: Open the Ploud view, where the user can set up the service.

csv.createFiles.desc: Export the cellar to CSV files and return an array of { path, size } (null on failure). With documents: true, the documents and the JSON data are exported too. Pass each path to sdk.network.upload.
csv.createFiles.snippet:
const files = await sdk.csv.createFiles({ documents: false });
return files;

csv.open.desc: Open the CSV export view, where the user can export and share their data.

pdf.createFile.desc: Print the cellar book to a PDF file and return { path, size } (null on failure). Without argument, prints all wines and all racks. With ids, prints only those objects: wines and racks can be mixed, PLOC finds each id. Accepts an array of ids (or objects with an id) or an options object. An empty array is rejected. Pass the path to sdk.ui.shareFiles or sdk.network.upload.

pdf.open.desc: Open the report center, where the user can print the cellar book.

miniApps.install.desc: Install a mini app from its url. Accepts a URL string or an options object.

translations.get.desc: Get PLOC native translations in the user's language. With a key, return the translated string. With an array of keys, return a dictionary { key: string }. An unknown key gives defaultValue (null by default). An empty key or an empty array is rejected.

miniApps.open.desc: Open the mini apps view, where the user can manage installed mini apps.

files.writeBase64.desc: Write a file from base64 content, overwriting any existing file. Accepts (path, base64) or an options object. Return { path, size } (null on failure). Pass the path to sdk.ui.shareFiles or sdk.network.upload.

files.writeText.desc: Write a text file, encoded as UTF-8 (accents are fine), overwriting any existing file. Same as sdk.files.writeBase64 without handling base64. Accepts (path, text) or an options object. Return { path, size } (null on failure).
files.writeText.snippet:
const file = await sdk.files.writeText("wines.csv", "name;vintage\nChâteau Margaux;2015\n");
await sdk.ui.shareFiles(file.path);

files.readBase64.desc: Read a file and return its content as base64, or null if it does not exist. Intended for small files: use sdk.network.download and sdk.network.upload for large ones. Accepts a path string or an options object.
files.readBase64.snippet:
const base64 = await sdk.files.readBase64("hello.txt");
return base64 === null ? null : atob(base64);

files.readText.desc: Read a text file decoded as UTF-8 (accents are fine), or null if it does not exist. Same as sdk.files.readBase64 without handling base64. Accepts a path string or an options object.
files.readText.snippet:
const text = await sdk.files.readText("wines.csv");
return text === null ? null : text.split("\n").length;

files.exists.desc: Check whether a file exists. Accepts a path string or an options object.

files.delete.desc: Delete a file. Return true if the file existed. Accepts a path string or an options object.
files.delete.snippet:
const existed = await sdk.files.delete("hello.txt");
return existed;

account.getInfo.desc: Get the account state: connected, and id, a stable anonymous user id derived from the given key (null without key or when not connected). Different keys give different ids. Accepts a key string or an options object.
account.getInfo.snippet:
const info = await sdk.account.getInfo("my-script");
return info;

app.getInfo.desc: Get information about the app and the system: name, version, build, platform, osVersion and locale.

app.getPermissions.desc: Get the permissions granted to the running script: { read, write }. Check them before reading or modifying data to avoid a permission error.
app.getPermissions.snippet:
const { read, write } = await sdk.app.getPermissions();
return { read, write };

storage.get.desc: Read a stored value. Returns the value with its original type (string, number, boolean, object, array), or defaultValue (null if omitted) when the key does not exist. Storage is shared by all scripts and synchronized with the cellar: prefix keys with your script name (e.g. "my-script.threshold") and prefer small, separate keys.
storage.get.snippet:
const threshold = await sdk.storage.get("my-script.threshold", 5);
return threshold;

storage.set.desc: Store a JSON-serializable value (string, number, boolean, object, array) under a key. Overwrites any existing value. undefined, functions, NaN and Infinity are rejected.
storage.set.snippet:
await sdk.storage.set("my-script.threshold", 10);
await sdk.storage.set("my-script.config", { enabled: true, tags: ["a", "b"] });

storage.has.desc: Check whether a key exists. Useful to tell a missing key from a stored null.

storage.remove.desc: Remove a key. Returns true if the key existed.

Model#save.desc: Save the object (create or update), then refresh it with the stored data. Available on all models except read-only ones.

Model#delete.desc: Delete the object. Available on all models except read-only ones.

Wine#delete.snippet:
const wine = await sdk.cellar.wine.findFirst("TEST");
await wine?.delete();

Wine#getCountry.desc: Get the country of the wine, loaded on demand (null if none).

Wine#getRegion.desc: Get the region of the wine, loaded on demand (null if none).

Wine#getAppellation.desc: Get the appellation of the wine, loaded on demand (null if none).

Wine#getClassification.desc: Get the classification of the wine, loaded on demand (null if none).

Wine#getColor.desc: Get the color of the wine, loaded on demand (null if none).

Wine#getBottleFormat.desc: Get the bottle format of the wine, loaded on demand (null if none).

Wine#getOwner.desc: Get the owner of the wine, loaded on demand (null if none).

Wine#getImage.desc: Get the image of the wine as a Document (null if none).

Wine#getRacks.desc: Get the racks holding this wine as a Collection. Throws INVALID_PARAMS if the wine has no id.

Wine#getTastingNotes.desc: Get the tasting notes of this wine as a Collection. Throws INVALID_PARAMS if the wine has no id.

Wine#getOrders.desc: Get the orders (purchases) of this wine as a Collection. Throws INVALID_PARAMS if the wine has no id.

Wine#getCoverImage.desc: Get the cover image of the wine as a Document (null if none).

Country#createRegion.desc: Create a region attached to this country. Call save() on the region to store it.

Country#getRegions.desc: Get the regions of the country as a Collection.

Region#getCountry.desc: Get the country of the region (null if none).

Region#getAppellations.desc: Get the appellations of the region as a Collection.

Region#createAppellation.desc: Create an appellation attached to this region. Call save() on the appellation to store it.

Appellation#getRegion.desc: Get the region of the appellation (null if none).

Contact#getCountry.desc: Get the country of the vendor or owner (null if none).

Order#getVendor.desc: Get the vendor of the order (null if none).

Order#getWine.desc: Get the wine of the order (null if none).

TastingNotes#getWine.desc: Get the wine of the tasting note (null if none).

TastingNotes#getImage.desc: Get the image of the tasting note as a Document (null if none).

Document#getBase64.desc: Get the content of the document as base64, loaded on demand.

Document#loadFromURL.desc: Download a URL into the document (base64) and use its last segment as filename. Return the base64 or null. Call save() to store it.

Document#loadFromFile.desc: Load a File or Blob into the document (base64, size, filename). Call save() to store it.

Rack#getRackItem.desc: Get the rack item at a position (row, column), or null.
Rack#getRackItem.snippet:
const rack = await sdk.cellar.rack.findFirst("NAME");
return rack.getRackItem(0, 0);

Rack#addRackItemAt.desc: Get or create the rack item at a position, optionally holding a wine. Throw if the position is outside the rack. Call save() on the rack to store it.

Rack#findRackItemByQrCode.desc: Get the rack item with a QR code, or null.
Rack#findRackItemByQrCode.snippet:
const rack = await sdk.cellar.rack.findFirst("NAME");
return rack.findRackItemByQrCode("QR_CODE");

Rack#findRackItemByTag.desc: Get the first rack item with a tag, or null.
Rack#findRackItemByTag.snippet:
const rack = await sdk.cellar.rack.findFirst("NAME");
return rack.findRackItemByTag("TAG");

Rack#populateRackItems.desc: Create the missing rack items so that every position of the rack has one. Call save() on the rack to store it.

Rack#isValidPosition.desc: Check whether a position (row, column) is inside the rack.
Rack#isValidPosition.snippet:
const rack = await sdk.cellar.rack.findFirst("NAME");
return rack.isValidPosition(0, 0);

RackItem#consume.desc: Consume the wine stored in the rack item (one bottle is taken out).

RackItem#store.desc: Store a wine in the rack item. The wine must have an id.

RackItem#markDeleted.desc: Mark the rack item as deleted (applied when the rack is saved).

RackItem#unmarkDeleted.desc: Remove the deleted mark of the rack item.
RackItem#unmarkDeleted.snippet:
const rack = await sdk.cellar.rack.findFirst("NAME");
return rack.getRackItem(0, 0).unmarkDeleted().isDeleted();

RackItem#toggleDeleted.desc: Toggle the deleted mark of the rack item.
RackItem#toggleDeleted.snippet:
const rack = await sdk.cellar.rack.findFirst("NAME");
return rack.getRackItem(0, 0).toggleDeleted().isDeleted();

RackItem#isEmpty.desc: Check whether the rack item holds no wine.
RackItem#isEmpty.snippet:
const rack = await sdk.cellar.rack.findFirst("NAME");
return rack.getRackItem(0, 0).isEmpty();

RackItem#isNotEmpty.desc: Check whether the rack item holds a wine.
RackItem#isNotEmpty.snippet:
const rack = await sdk.cellar.rack.findFirst("NAME");
return rack.getRackItem(0, 0).isNotEmpty();

RackItem#isDeleted.desc: Check whether the rack item is marked as deleted.
RackItem#isDeleted.snippet:
const rack = await sdk.cellar.rack.findFirst("NAME");
return rack.getRackItem(0, 0).isDeleted();

Collection#forEach.desc: Call a function for each item. Return the collection.
Collection#forEach.snippet:
const wines = await sdk.cellar.wine.getAll();
wines.forEach(w => console.log(w.name));

Collection#map.desc: Return a new Collection with the result of a function on each item. Use toArray() to get a plain array.
Collection#map.snippet:
const wines = await sdk.cellar.wine.getAll();
return wines.map(w => w.name).toArray();

Collection#filter.desc: Return a new Collection with the items for which a function returns true.
Collection#filter.snippet:
const wines = await sdk.cellar.wine.getAll();
return wines.filter(w => w.vintage >= 2015).count;

Collection#filterBy.desc: Return a new Collection with the items whose property (dotted path allowed) matches a value. Options: ignoreCase (boolean), mode ("equals" or "startsWith").
Collection#filterBy.snippet:
const wines = await sdk.cellar.wine.getAll();
return wines.filterBy("name", "cha", { ignoreCase: true, mode: "startsWith" }).count;

Collection#find.desc: Get the first item whose property (dotted path allowed) equals a value, or undefined.
Collection#find.snippet:
const wines = await sdk.cellar.wine.getAll();
return wines.find("vintage", 2015)?.name;

Collection#sortBy.desc: Return a new sorted Collection by a property (dotted path allowed). Direction is "asc" (default) or "desc"; empty values go last.
Collection#sortBy.snippet:
const wines = await sdk.cellar.wine.getAll();
return wines.sortBy("vintage", "desc").map(w => w.name).toArray();

Collection#at.desc: Get the item at an index (negative counts from the end), or undefined.
Collection#at.snippet:
const wines = await sdk.cellar.wine.getAll();
return wines.at(-1)?.name;

Collection#toArray.desc: Return the items as a plain array.
Collection#toArray.snippet:
const wines = await sdk.cellar.wine.getAll();
return wines.toArray().length;
